name: Easy Start (3-player)
description: A shorter Dragon game for learning (D65, decision 0016): Easy Start's piece settings, every attack on a King is check, the Tail is the Dragon's King on A5, E5 and I5, and the first checkmate wins. Casual play only; not fairness-checked.
notes: Played before S68 built coast.3p.exit, so every Coast piece could leave the Coast with any legal move. Kept with a lock (any-legal-move) so its games and fairness reports replay as they were played (decision 0019).
